equalRates.title: Equal Base Rates
equalRates.text: When both groups have the same underlying base rate, it's possible to achieve fairness on all metrics simultaneously. Try toggling "Different Base Rates" to see the impossibility theorem in action.

differentRates.title: The Trade-off in Action
differentRates.textTemplate: {satisfied}/4 metrics satisfied. With different base rates ({rateA}% vs {rateB}%), adjusting the threshold to satisfy one metric often violates another. This is the fundamental fairness trade-off in ML.
